name: sam-achievement-manager-web
description: Modern UI redesign of Steam Achievement Manager (web prototype) — React + Vite + TypeScript port of the Claude Design handoff.

scripts.test:web: npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --manifest-path steam-core/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets --all-features
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path steam-core/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path steam-core/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.test:native: npm run tauri -- build --debug --no-bundle --ci && npm run smoke:native
scripts.test:all: npm run test:web && npm run test:rust && npm run lint:rust && npm run test:native
